body: From the DM-175 review (orchestrator): when you expose `recordEscapedDefects` (src/core/services/escapedDefects.ts), note two things. Reports recorded in one call share the millisecond, and the read model orders them by observationId, not call order. So a report and its withdrawal sent in one call can read as still counted. And retrying a batch that holds an attributed report followed by an unattributed one, with descending caller ids, fails with a spurious `conflict`. Use server-allocated, monotonically ordered ids, or reuse the stored row's attribution on a retry.
